configs.description: The finger duct as Tripp Lite ships SRCABLEDUCT1UFC, yellow, the cover fitted.

configs.description: The same duct with the snap-on cover taken off, the two slotted walls and the channel between them open to lay a cable in. The cover comes with the duct, so this is an illustration and not a device type.

gaps.note: the spec sheet prints 4.130 x 2.170 x 19.480 in as height, width, depth; 19.48 is the width, and which of the other two is the depth is not stated. 2.170 is taken as the height and 4.130 as the depth because the part is 1U. No drawing or manual settled it.

gaps.note: no dimensioned drawing was found: the submittal drawing's address returns an error page. The walls, the slots, the cover's reach, the ears and the two rear windows are estimated.

no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays

attrs.note: datasheet - colour (yellow), material (high-visibility yellow steel), the mounting hardware (included), the cables it is for (fibre, copper and coax) and compliance (RoHS) are the spec sheet's.

capacity.note: datasheet - the spec sheet states no cable capacity, fill or bend radius. None is recorded and none is estimated; gaps say so.

chassis.note: datasheet - 494.79 x 55.12 x 104.9 (19.480 x 2.170 x 4.130 in), the spec sheet's figures in the order `size-conflict` settles. THE HEIGHT IS MORE THAN ONE RACK UNIT (44.45 mm) and the part is stated as 1U ("Horizontal Cable Manager - Finger Duct with Cover, Yellow, 1U"). The part states `ru: 1`.

color.note: estimated - "Color: Yellow" and "high-visibility yellow steel" are the spec sheet's; no sampled value exists, so #f2c200 is this library's render of it. It is carried as a field (`finish`) that the `base` configuration sets on every part, so a colour is one word and not a second drawing, and the outline is a fixed shade of the fill so the yellow reads on a white stage as well as the dark one.

cover.note: datasheet - the cover ships fitted and snaps off (the spec sheet's highlights "Convenient snap-on cover allows quick unconstrained access to cabling", its description "The snap-on cover lets you rapidly add or remove cables"). It is drawn fitted in `base` and absent in `cover-off`, as a lid (`lid: true`). A snap-on cover is a removable part, not a hinge, and no clip is drawn: the format has none and no document draws one.

ears.note: estimated - a rack-face part is its ears and what hangs off them. The spec sheet's width is 19.480 in, 494.79 mm, more than the 482.6 of 19.00 in: the ears seem to stand out past the rack face (the pictures show tabs at the end), and no document says by how much. The face is drawn the whole 494.79 and the ears are the 31.5 mm at each end, which leaves the 431.8 of the maker's SRCABLEDUCT1U between them; each has two slots where an EIA-310 ear has its holes (465 mm between centres, 14.9 mm in from the end, 32 mm apart; 12 x 6 mm).

front.note: estimated - the cover, fitted: a front plate across the channel (the picture of the duct from the front shows a solid front face; the cover lifted clear is a flat strip). The two walls and the channel between them are drawn as the SRCABLEDUCT1U's drawing gives its own, 1.1 mm walls standing 1.1 mm in from the top and bottom, which leaves 50.72 mm clear. The `duct` guide is that channel over the 431.8 mm between the ears.

guides.note: estimated - FINGERS ON BOTH WALLS, 24 SLOTS A WALL, COUNTED ON THE MAKER'S PHOTOGRAPHS. The spec sheet's features say "Fingers on either side"; its pictures show a row of slots along the top wall, and the picture of the duct with the cover lifted shows slots in both walls. 24 slots across 431.8 mm is the 18.0 pitch of the SRCABLEDUCT1U's drawing, an 8.0 mm slot between 10.0 mm bars (by eye). The slots are closed at both ends, as that drawing draws them. The "proper bend radius" the sheet claims is the shape of the fingers and states no radius (gap `bend-radius`). A cable is laid along the channel and passes between the walls through a slot.

left.note: estimated - the side: the back plate, the two walls with the channel between them, and the cover's plate and lips over the front. The duct is open at both ends and a cable runs out of it there: nothing is built across the ends. The right is the same, turned round.

mount.note: datasheet - `rack-face`: the spec sheet says the manager mounts "on either the front or the rear of your rack cabinet or open frame rack", with all hardware included for an EIA-standard 19 in rack. It bolts to the rail face at one rack unit and stands out of it. No document shows how far the back plate stands behind the ear plane, so `depth` is the overall 104.9 and the whole of it is taken as projecting. It is one part for both faces: the format places a rack-face part on either face, and the placement says which.

passes.note: estimated - TWO WINDOWS IN THE BACK PLATE, from the maker's picture of the rear: two long openings either side of a centre block (two small dark squares, not drawn: no document says what they are), each showing the fingers behind it. The spec sheet says "pass-through holes in the rear allow convenient access to cabling for routing and separation of bundles". Each is 122.7 x 22 mm (0.126 to 0.374 of the length from each end, about half the height), by eye on a perspective view, so the size is a stand-in. Open: nothing is said to close them. A cable crosses from the front of the duct to the rear through one, with the cover off.

rear.note: estimated - the back plate with its ears and their slots and the two windows of `passes`.

size-conflict.note: THE SPEC SHEET'S AXES ARE OUT OF ORDER, AND NO OTHER MAKER DOCUMENT SETTLES WHICH IS THE DEPTH. "Unit Dimensions (hwd / in.) 4.130 x 2.170 x 19.480" (10.490 x 5.511 x 49.50 cm): the inch and centimetre figures agree, but 19.48 in is plainly the width, so the order is not h, w, d. The part is 1U and a 1U part is not 4.13 in (104.9 mm) tall, so the 2.170 in (55.12 mm) is taken as the height and the 4.130 in as the depth. The inference is the model's and not a maker's statement; the pictures show the duct deeper than it is tall. The owner is asked to accept it. Both figures are over their 1U values (44.45 mm), and the 19.48 in width is 12.2 mm wider than the 19.00 in rack face (see `ears`).

sources.note: THE MAKER'S OWN DOCUMENT AND NOTHING ELSE. The SRCABLEDUCT1UFC spec sheet (assets.tripplite.com, 2 pages, © 2026 Eaton): five pictures, a description, features, applications and a specification table. The submittal drawing at the address the SRCABLEDUCT1U's follows returns an XML error page, not a PDF; the Eaton SKU page was tried once (the .html and the skuPage .pdf export both fail at the connection with an HTTP/2 stream error, and a regional copy timed out). So no dimension is drawn and every figure but the unit size is estimated. Nothing is copied from the pictures.

thickness.note: estimated - no document states the gauge; 1.1 mm is the SRCABLEDUCT1U's, a drawing of the same maker's 1U steel duct.

top.note: estimated - the plan, rear at y=0: the back 5.0 mm, the wall, and the cover's lip over the front 12.0 mm; the 24 slots run from 8.0 mm in front of the back to under the lip. The bottom is the same as the top.

weight.note: datasheet - 0.68 kg (1.500 lb), the spec sheet's Unit Weight.
